title: On Weighing the grain sack by sack
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：weigh　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 weigh 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the teacher ① weighed the grain sack by sack with great care, and every pupil in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the teacher ② weighs the grain sack by sack on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ weigh the grain sack by sack at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ weighed the grain sack by sack before — a line in the notebook for March 1970 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Weighing the grain sack by sack with great care, the teacher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ weigh the two offers carefully on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Weigh the two offers carefully at once and never mention it again.

By 1983 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new pupil from the next classroom ⑧ weighs the two offers carefully with great care every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the blackboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ weighed the grain sack by sack again when nobody else would.

⑩ To weigh the grain sack by sack, my mother said in 1988, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the classroom remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the classroom forgets, somebody weighs the grain sack by sack on the same day again and somebody must weigh the grain sack by sack with great care all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 称量（一般过去式 weighed the grain sack by sack：1976 年先生头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 称量（一般现在 weighs the grain sack by sack：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 称量（不定式 to weigh the grain sack by sack：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 称量（过去完成时 had weighed the grain sack by sack：1970 年三月的笔记簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 称量（动名词 weighing the grain sack by sack 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 权衡（weigh the two offers carefully：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去权衡仔细权衡那两项提议）
G. v. 权衡（weigh the two offers carefully：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 称量（后段两处：新来的学童照例 weighs the two offers carefully，而母亲又一次 weighed the grain sack by sack）

weigh 意为“称量”，结尾那句是母亲 1988 年的话：要称量把粮食一袋袋称过，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和教室记住的那一件。

answers: In 1976 the teacher weighed the grain sack by sack with great care, and nobody in the classroom forgot it.
Even now the teacher weighs the grain sack by sack on the same day whenever the classroom asks.
